feature: Complete bounded real equations, disequalities and inequalities containing rational absolute-value expressions

implementation.algorithm: Enumerate the disjoint argument >= 0 and argument < 0 cases for every distinct Abs, including nested occurrences. Independently check each structural replacement and require the complete sign-assignment roster. Each branch uses the existing independently checked native rational constraint engine.
implementation.domains: Held Add/Mul/Pow retain original poles through cancellation, zero factors, zeroth powers and equal equation sides. Restrict exact branch sets to the requested real domain before taking their union.
implementation.source_integrity: Closed scalar/function owners, typed symbols, original argument tuples, native handles and domain storage are retained and rechecked. Foreign or mutated sources refuse.
implementation.outcomes: Closed unsupported Abs forms preserve the original ConditionSet. Exhausted bounds, wrong replacements, missing sign branches and later branch failures propagate; partial answers are never returned.
implementation.evidence_scope: Structural branch checking plus the existing exact rational sign-chart checker. No portable Abs certificate, global compatibility claim or workstream closure.
